How to Crack UPSC in Your First Attempt? | AIR 170 Abhijeet Jain's 5-Hour Strategy

Can you prepare for UPSC CSE while managing college or a full-time job? And is it possible to clear the examination in your very first attempt with just 5 hours of focused study every day?

In this session, Dr. Abhijeet Jain (AIR 170, UPSC CSE 2025) shares his preparation journey and a practical strategy for beginners aspiring to crack UPSC Civil Services Examination in their first attempt.

Abhijeet cleared UPSC CSE in his first attempt while working as a doctor at Safdarjung Hospital. Drawing from his experience, he explains how to structure your preparation, manage limited study hours and approach each stage of the examination.

In this session, you will learn:

- How to structure a 5-hour daily UPSC study schedule.
- Why active recall and regular revision are essential for effective preparation.
- How to approach GS subjects, optional preparation and current affairs.
- How to prepare for UPSC Prelims through revision and mock tests.
- How to use PYQs to make your Mains preparation more focused.
- How to approach answer writing and essay preparation.
- How college students and working professionals can manage UPSC preparation alongside their existing commitments.
- How to maintain consistency, build discipline and stay motivated throughout the preparation journey.

Whether you are starting your UPSC preparation from scratch, studying alongside college or managing a full-time job, this session offers practical insights into building a structured and realistic preparation strategy.

About the Speaker:

Dr. Abhijeet Jain secured AIR 170 in UPSC CSE 2025 in his first attempt. He shares how he balanced his professional responsibilities with UPSC preparation and the strategies that helped him navigate the examination.

If you are targeting UPSC CSE 2028 or preparing for your first attempt, this session will help you understand how to approach your preparation with greater clarity.
